expects.query: Plan only a dev Alerts real-time Docker Compose deployment using chunking mode and no agent harness. Do not generate files, perform host setup, or deploy.
checks: The agent honors the explicit Chunking selection and does not ask a streaming-backend question.
Its plan uses the inherited chunked rule config and integrated RTVI, leaves native streaming disabled, and adds no streaming NIM or native-streaming tuning.
No artifacts are generated, no services are started, and checked-in configs are unchanged.

expects.query: Replace that plan with streaming VLM native inside RTVI, still for the dev Alerts real-time Docker Compose profile, and still plan only with no file or host changes. Keep the default Nano BF16 VLM.
checks: The agent treats Streaming/native as already selected and does not repeat either inference-selection question.
Its plan selects the integrated backend with RTVI_STREAMING_VLM_ENABLED=true and the documented streaming settings, without a separate NIM service or custom RTVI build.
It plans a build-local always-on rule payload with streaming_vlm, ordered frames, a one-second non-overlapping step, one frame per step, an eight-frame window, and a complete task in system_prompt.
It preserves the distinction between dev Alerts real-time mode and CV verification/Helm/standalone deployments.
